zoom.label: The man's right hand at the left edge of the picture, holding the small square mirror

c1.text: Level one: he holds two mirrors so she can see her back. Now zoom to his hand at the left edge: the small mirror.

zoom.label: The man's right hand at the left edge of the picture, holding the small square mirror

c1q.text: What do we see of the small mirror?

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, Aline François, 'La Femme au miroir', Premiers feux au musée (2016-2017), p. 11 (our translations)
J. A. Crowe and G. B. Cavalcaselle, Titian: His Life and Times, 2nd ed., vol. I (London, 1881), p. 268

c1a.text: Her reflection is for her eyes only.

correction.truth: It is turned to her; we see only its back.
correction.evidence: The Louvre's 2017 text: one mirror shown from the back. Crowe and Cavalcaselle (1881). The crop.

c1b.text: Yes. It faces her, so we see only its back. She looks into it; we never see what she sees.

c1c.text: His face is above it, in shadow.

correction.tempting: He is holding it close to himself.
correction.truth: It is turned to her; we see only its back.
correction.evidence: The Louvre's 2017 text: one mirror shown from the back. Crowe and Cavalcaselle (1881). The crop.

c1m.text: She sees her back; we see the mirror's back.

zoom.label: Her left hand on the grey stone ledge, bottom right, with a ring on one finger

c2.text: Level one: she is in the middle of her toilette. Now zoom to the bottom right, on the stone ledge: her left hand.

zoom.label: Her left hand on the grey stone ledge, bottom right, with a ring on one finger

c2q.text: What is under her left hand?

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, Aline François, 'La Femme au miroir', Premiers feux au musée (2016-2017), p. 11 (our translations)
J. A. Crowe and G. B. Cavalcaselle, Titian: His Life and Times, 2nd ed., vol. I (London, 1881), p. 268

c2a.text: Round and shiny, but not a mirror.

correction.truth: It is a small jar, of perfume or ointment.
correction.evidence: The Louvre's 2017 text: a bottle of perfume. Crowe and Cavalcaselle (1881): the ointment vase.

correction.tempting: It is round and fits her hand.
correction.truth: It is a small jar, of perfume or ointment.
correction.evidence: The Louvre's 2017 text: a bottle of perfume. Crowe and Cavalcaselle (1881): the ointment vase.

c2c.text: Yes: a perfume bottle for the Louvre, an ointment vase for Crowe and Cavalcaselle. Either way, it belongs to her toilette.

c2m.text: Hair in one hand, a jar in the other: a toilette in progress.

zoom.label: Her neck, shoulders and the gathered neckline of the white chemise

c3.text: Level one: Titian painted a Venetian beauty. Now zoom to her neck and shoulders, and the white chemise.

zoom.label: Her neck, shoulders and the gathered neckline of the white chemise

c3q.text: Which shoulder does the chemise leave most bare?

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, Aline François, 'La Femme au miroir', Premiers feux au musée (2016-2017), p. 11 (our translations)
J. A. Crowe and G. B. Cavalcaselle, Titian: His Life and Times, 2nd ed., vol. I (London, 1881), p. 268

c3a.text: Yes: her left shoulder, on our right, is the bare one. The Louvre's text says the same: the chemise shows mainly her left shoulder.

c3b.text: Her right is mostly covered by the chemise.

correction.tempting: Her raised right arm is bare, where the sleeve falls away.
correction.truth: The barer shoulder is her left, on our right.
correction.evidence: The Louvre's 2017 text: mainly her left shoulder. Crowe and Cavalcaselle (1881): the bare right arm. The crop.

correction.tempting: Both shoulders show some skin above the neckline.
correction.truth: Her left shoulder, on our right, is far barer.
correction.evidence: The Louvre's 2017 text: the chemise shows mainly her left shoulder. The crop.

c3m.text: Remember: her left is our right.

extends.concept: From why he holds two mirrors (level) to what that leaves us: only the plain back of the small one

c1q.what_you_learn: The small square mirror in the man's right hand is turned to her, so the viewer sees only its back and never her reflection.
